funding.title: Funding
funding.help: Write the funder's full name as the award letter gives it. An identifier from ROR or Crossref's register of funders matches the funder exactly, and the award number links a dataset to the funded project.

subjects.label: Subjects
subjects.help: A subject can be an organism, an environment or a keyword. Exports carry each term with its vocabulary, so others find the study by it.
subjects.searchPlaceholder: Search terms, or type a keyword
subjects.hint: Type at least two letters to search.
subjects.unreachable: The term search could not be reached. You can still add a keyword.

design.help: How the study is arranged, in a sentence or two.
design.placeholder: e.g. Four sites sampled weekly from May to September

relatedWork.title: Related work
relatedWork.help: Papers, datasets or pages related to the study, each with how it relates.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.description: You have changes that are not saved. If you leave now, they are lost.

dictionary.purpose: Every column this experiment has recorded. Saying what a column measures lets exports and other researchers read your data without asking you.
dictionary.producerUploadCaption: Files read by the platform's {{parser}} parser
dictionary.producerLayoutCaption: The Layout tab names every plot, so these columns need no description.
dictionary.producerUnknownCaption: These readings carry no device details.
dictionary.loadFailed: The columns could not be loaded.
dictionary.empty: No columns yet. They appear once this experiment has readings.
dictionary.readOnly: Only people who can edit this experiment can describe its columns.

describe.intro: Only the definition and the property are required.
describe.definitionHelp: What the column holds, in your own words.
describe.definitionPlaceholder: e.g. Relative humidity of the air beside the plot at each reading
describe.propertyHelp: The quality measured, such as temperature or a count.
describe.objectOfInterestHelp: What the property belongs to, such as air, a leaf or soil.
describe.methodHelp: Starts from the column's origin, and you can add to it.
describe.methodPlaceholder: e.g. Sensor reading taken with each measurement
describe.methodUpload: Read from {{parser}} files by parser version {{version}}
describe.unitHelp: A UCUM code, such as Cel, % or umol/(m2.s). Empty for text.
describe.contextHelp: Anything else the value depends on, such as a depth, a time of day or a daily mean.
describe.processingLevelHelp: Starts from what produced the column.

term.label: Term
term.labelObjectOfInterest: Term for the object of interest
term.propertyHelp: Choosing No term fits counts the column as done.
term.hint: Type at least two letters to search.
term.unreachable: The term search could not be reached. You can save without a term and add one later.
term.partlyUnreachable: {{sources}} did not answer, so these results leave it out.

describe.readOnly: Only people who can edit this experiment can describe its columns.

suggestion.matchInstrument_one: Same instrument field in {{count}} other experiment
suggestion.matchInstrument_other: Same instrument field in {{count}} other experiments
suggestion.matchMacro_one: Same macro field in {{count}} other experiment
suggestion.matchMacro_other: Same macro field in {{count}} other experiments
suggestion.earlierVersion: Same column in version {{version}} of this workbook
suggestion.hint: Nothing is saved until you press Save.
suggestion.applied: Filled in from the suggestion. Check the values, then save.
